objective: Define the logical tree-KV address space and immutable identity model for tokens, branches, and physical pages.
mathematical_spec: Let T=(V,E) be a rooted token tree. Each node v has logical position p(v), parent par(v), branch id b(v), and KV address a(v)=(page(v),offset(v)). Require p(root)=0, p(v)=p(par(v))+1 on an edge, and a(v) unique per materialized token unless explicitly shared by ancestry.
implementation_prompt: Specify C++ data structures and API contracts for logical token nodes, branch identifiers, and page/offset addresses. Map the design onto llama_kv_cache/llama_kv_cells concepts without implementing kernels. State ownership, lifetime, and serialization semantics.

objective: Specify fixed-size KV page geometry for tree decoding across layers and K/V tensor layouts.
mathematical_spec: For page capacity P tokens and L layers, page bytes B_page=sum_l P*(bytes(K_l)+bytes(V_l)); valid offsets satisfy 0<=o<P. Page geometry must be constant for one cache arena and compatible with backend alignment A: base(page) mod A=0.
implementation_prompt: Define page size parameters, per-layer strides, alignment requirements, and how a logical page maps to backend buffers for standard, quantized, and K-only/MLA layouts. Keep the spec backend-neutral.

objective: Define page descriptor metadata and lifecycle states.
mathematical_spec: Descriptor d_i=(state,generation,refcount,used,owner_epoch). state in {FREE,RESERVED,LIVE,RETIRING}; 0<=used<=P; refcount>=0. A page is reusable iff state=FREE and refcount=0.
implementation_prompt: Specify the page descriptor struct, generation counters for ABA protection, state transitions, and invariants. Include which fields are host-visible versus mirrored to device metadata.

objective: Define branch descriptors linking tree topology to ordered page spans.
mathematical_spec: For branch b, path(b) is represented by prefix-shared span list S_b=[(page_j,lo_j,hi_j)]. Concatenating spans yields exactly the materialized tokens on root-to-tip(b), preserving logical position order.
implementation_prompt: Specify branch metadata containing parent branch, fork position, tip position, ordered page spans, and generation/epoch. Define lookup from logical position to page span and rules for shallow copies at fork.

objective: Specify ancestry intervals for constant-time visibility checks in tree attention metadata.
mathematical_spec: Assign DFS interval [tin(v),tout(v)] so u is ancestor of v iff tin(u)<=tin(v)<tout(u). For dynamic draft trees, use branch ancestry ids plus fork positions: key k is visible to query q iff same lineage prefix and p(k)<=p(q).
implementation_prompt: Define the host metadata needed to answer ancestor/visibility predicates without traversing parent pointers per token. Compare interval labels versus branch/fork descriptors and choose an update-friendly representation.

objective: Define the page table mapping branch-local logical positions to physical KV pages.
mathematical_spec: PT_b[j]=(page_id,generation,base_pos,valid_len). Resolve(b,p) chooses unique entry j with base_pos<=p<base_pos+valid_len and returns offset p-base_pos. Resolution must reject stale generations.
implementation_prompt: Specify branch page-table entries, lookup rules, cacheability, and stale-entry detection. Include contiguous and fragmented branches and requirements for batched GPU upload.

objective: Define free-page pool semantics and allocation ordering.
mathematical_spec: Let F be the set of FREE page ids. alloc(n) returns distinct ids A subset F with |A|=n and atomically moves them to RESERVED. free(A) is legal only when refcount=0 and generation matches; then generation increments before re-entry into F.
implementation_prompt: Specify a host-side allocator contract, free-list/bitmap alternatives, deterministic allocation for tests, and failure semantics under pressure. No implementation yet.

objective: Specify batched page reservation for a draft tree expansion step.
mathematical_spec: For branches i with requested new tokens t_i, pages_needed_i=max(0,ceil((tail_free_i+t_i)/P)-tail_pages_already_owned_i). Reservation succeeds atomically for all branches or returns a deficit without partial publication.
implementation_prompt: Define reservation input/output for many branches, handling existing tail slack, atomic failure, and rollback of RESERVED pages. Target one scheduler call per draft expansion.

objective: Define page publication from RESERVED to LIVE after KV writes complete.
mathematical_spec: A RESERVED page may transition to LIVE only after all required K/V writes in its published valid range happen-before publication. Let W be write completion event; publish requires W <=_hb LIVE visibility.
implementation_prompt: Specify publication barriers/events for CPU, CUDA, and other backends at the contract level. State how valid_len advances and how readers avoid partially written KV.

objective: Define reference counting for ancestry-shared pages.
mathematical_spec: For page x, rc(x)=|{b : x is referenced by branch b page table}| plus transient pins. Every branch-table publication increments before visibility; every removal decrements after readers quiesce. rc(x)=0 is necessary for reclamation.
implementation_prompt: Specify refcount operations, ownership accounting, transient pins, overflow policy, and debug reconciliation by recomputing references from branch tables.

objective: Specify fork-time page sharing without KV copying.
mathematical_spec: Fork child c from parent b at position f. All fully covered prefix pages are shared and refcounts incremented. If f splits a page, the child initially shares that page read-only through offset f mod P and marks the tail as COW-required.
implementation_prompt: Define fork metadata update rules, treatment of partial tail pages, and O(number_of_page_spans) behavior. Align semantics with existing seq_cp-style sharing where possible.

objective: Define copy-on-write for divergent writes into a shared tail page.
mathematical_spec: If write target page x has rc(x)>1 or write range overlaps a read-only shared prefix, allocate y, copy preserved prefix [0,o), write divergent suffix to y, then atomically swap child PT entry from x to y and decrement rc(x).
implementation_prompt: Specify COW trigger predicates, copy ranges, publication ordering, and failure rollback. Include a fast path when the child owns an unshared tail page.

objective: Specify append allocation for branches that cross page boundaries.
mathematical_spec: Appending t tokens at tip q consumes s=min(t,P-used_tail) tail slots, then k=ceil((t-s)/P) new pages. Logical positions remain contiguous even if physical page ids are arbitrary.
implementation_prompt: Define append planning that emits physical write segments for one branch, including tail fill plus newly allocated pages. Ensure resulting segments can feed existing ubatch-style execution.

objective: Define multi-branch append planning for one packed draft microbatch.
mathematical_spec: Given branch token counts t_i, produce disjoint write segments W_i and a packed token permutation pi such that every query token maps to exactly one (page,offset) and preserves per-branch logical order.
implementation_prompt: Specify the batch planner interface and metadata outputs for packed draft branches, including branch offsets, page ids, offsets, and logical positions needed by attention.

objective: Define physical KV write indexing from packed draft tokens.
mathematical_spec: For packed token index r, write destination dst(r)=(page_id[r],offset[r]); injectivity must hold for concurrently written r unless writes are bit-identical shared-prefix materializations, which should be excluded from normal append.
implementation_prompt: Specify index tensors/buffers for scattering K and V of packed tokens into paged storage across layers. State shape/dtype/alignment contracts only.

objective: Specify page pinning during asynchronous attention reads.
mathematical_spec: A reader acquiring page x increments or records a read pin before dereference and releases after completion event. Reclaim(x) may proceed only when rc(x)=0 and pins(x)=0 and all retire epochs are quiescent.
implementation_prompt: Define a minimal pin/epoch contract compatible with asynchronous GPU work so pruning cannot recycle pages still in use. Compare explicit pins with epoch-based reclamation and choose the simpler safe baseline.

objective: Define branch rollback to an ancestor position after speculative rejection.
mathematical_spec: Rollback branch b from tip t to accepted a<=t removes all page-table coverage for positions p>a, truncates the surviving tail valid_len to a-base_pos+1, and decrements refs for removed pages after reader quiescence.
implementation_prompt: Specify rollback metadata operations and page reclamation sequence for accepted-prefix lengths. Include boundary cases a at page edge, within shared page, and empty speculative suffix.

objective: Define pruning of rejected sibling branches.
mathematical_spec: For rejected branch set R, remove every reference reachable only from R while preserving shared prefix pages referenced by surviving branches S. Page x is reclaimable iff post-prune rc(x)=0 and no pins remain.
implementation_prompt: Specify whole-branch pruning as an atomic metadata operation over a set of sibling branches. Require idempotence and no effect on surviving branch page tables.

objective: Define commit of one accepted speculative branch into the canonical sequence.
mathematical_spec: Commit winner w aliases or transfers its ordered page spans into canonical branch c for positions beyond common prefix, then retires competing branches. Postcondition path(c)=accepted token path and each live page refcount matches published tables.
implementation_prompt: Specify zero-copy commit where possible, refcount deltas, canonical branch identity handling, and ordering relative to rejection pruning.

objective: Define partial acceptance when a verified path ends inside a shared/COW page.
mathematical_spec: For accepted endpoint a inside page x, canonical valid coverage ends at offset o=a-base_pos. Bytes beyond o may exist physically but must be unreachable from canonical PT; reuse requires COW/truncation semantics that do not expose stale KV.
implementation_prompt: Specify how partial-page acceptance updates visibility and ownership without clearing unnecessary bytes. State when a later append may reuse the tail versus force COW.

objective: Specify branch-id and generation reuse without stale-handle aliasing.
mathematical_spec: A branch handle h=(id,gen) is valid iff table[id].generation=gen and state=LIVE. On recycle, generation increments modulo a width large enough that wraparound cannot occur within maximum outstanding handle lifetime.
implementation_prompt: Define branch handle lifecycle, free-id pool, generation checks, and error behavior for stale asynchronous work.

objective: Define allocator fragmentation metrics for paged tree KV.
mathematical_spec: Let free_pages=F, largest_contiguous_run=C, live_tail_waste=sum_b(P-used_tail_b), and internal_waste=sum_live_pages(P-valid_tokens). Report external fragmentation phi_ext=1-C/max(F,1) only when contiguous runs matter, and occupancy eta=used_tokens/(live_pages*P).
implementation_prompt: Specify measurable fragmentation/occupancy counters suited to fixed-page allocation, separating page-level scarcity from tail slack and metadata fragmentation.

objective: Define tail-page compaction opportunities across branches.
mathematical_spec: A compaction candidate set C contains live pages with low occupancy whose tokens can be relocated without violating logical order or sharing. Relocation gain G=sum freed_pages - copy_cost_weight*bytes_moved must exceed threshold.
implementation_prompt: Specify when partial tail pages can be compacted, explicitly excluding pages shared across incompatible branch prefixes unless COW first resolves ownership.

objective: Define a relocation plan for page compaction/defragmentation.
mathematical_spec: Plan R is a set of moves (src_page,src_range,dst_page,dst_range) with non-overlapping destinations and a page-table rewrite map. Correctness requires KV value preservation and atomic switch from old to new PT generation.
implementation_prompt: Specify relocation plan construction and metadata required to execute it through existing cache-update machinery. Include cycle handling via scratch page or ordered moves.

objective: Define safe publication of a completed page relocation.
mathematical_spec: Let copy completion event C precede PT switch S, and all readers of old generation quiesce before reclaim R: C <=_hb S <=_hb R. Readers must resolve either entirely old or entirely new descriptor generation.
implementation_prompt: Specify two-phase relocation publication, generation bumping, and delayed reclamation. Cover failure before and after PT switch.

objective: Specify memory-pressure policy for tree KV page reservations.
mathematical_spec: Given free pages F and reservation demand D, admit if D<=F-reserve_floor. Otherwise choose pressure action ordered by cost: prune dead branches, release retired pages, compact if beneficial, then reduce draft breadth/depth before hard OOM.
implementation_prompt: Define pressure signals and scheduler responses as policy data, not hardcoded behavior. Include hysteresis so breadth does not oscillate every decoding step.

objective: Define per-branch KV residency accounting and quota signals.
mathematical_spec: resident_pages(b)=shared_weighted_pages(b)+exclusive_pages(b), where a shared page contribution may be 1/rc(x) for accounting. Sum of physical live pages remains allocator ground truth and must not be double counted.
implementation_prompt: Specify accounting metrics that let the scheduler attribute memory cost to speculative branches while preserving exact physical totals.

objective: Define serialization format for tree-KV metadata checkpoints.
mathematical_spec: Checkpoint captures cache geometry, page generations, branch handles/topology, page tables, logical positions, valid lengths, and enough KV bytes to reconstruct all LIVE references. Restore must produce an isomorphic logical tree with equal visible KV values.
implementation_prompt: Specify a versioned checkpoint schema compatible in spirit with llama sequence state save/restore. Separate logical metadata from backend buffer payloads and state explicit compatibility checks.

objective: Define restore into a fragmented destination arena.
mathematical_spec: Restore maps serialized logical pages S to any distinct free destination pages D of equal geometry; physical ids need not match. Rebuilt page tables use the new mapping while preserving branch paths and page sharing equivalence classes.
implementation_prompt: Specify restore mapping, atomic failure semantics, and validation for fragmented free space, informed by existing fragmented state-restore behavior.

objective: Define tree-KV consistency checking for debug and tests.
mathematical_spec: Check: all LIVE PT refs target LIVE matching generations; recomputed rc equals stored rc minus documented transient pins; logical ranges per branch are ordered/non-overlapping; parent-child prefixes agree through fork position; no writable alias violates COW.
implementation_prompt: Specify an O(total_page_table_entries) verifier with precise failure diagnostics. It must be callable at phase boundaries in tests without mutating cache state.

objective: Define token-to-visible-page gather metadata for Tree PagedAttention.
mathematical_spec: For each query q, visible KV set V(q) is the ordered ancestor path tokens up to q. Represent V(q) as ordered page segments G_q=[(page,lo,hi)] whose concatenated logical positions equal V(q) exactly once.
implementation_prompt: Specify gather metadata that attention kernels can consume without materializing a dense tree mask. Include query-to-segment offsets for packed batches.

objective: Specify block table packing for GPU Tree PagedAttention.
mathematical_spec: Pack all G_q segments into flat arrays page_ids, lo, hi with row_ptr[q]: segments for q are indices [row_ptr[q],row_ptr[q+1]). Total segment count M determines metadata O(M), independent of dense Q*K mask size.
implementation_prompt: Define exact integer widths, memory layout, device upload lifetime, and alignment for CSR-like per-query page segment tables.

objective: Define causal and ancestry masking semantics inside gathered pages.
mathematical_spec: Attention edge (q,k) is allowed iff k belongs to q ancestry and p(k)<=p(q), plus model-specific window constraints. Scores for disallowed edges are -infinity before softmax.
implementation_prompt: Specify mask semantics shared by CPU reference and optimized paged attention. Include BOS/root handling, duplicate logical positions, and packed branches.

objective: Extend visibility semantics for sliding-window attention.
mathematical_spec: With window W(q), visible keys satisfy ancestry(q,k) and max(window_start(q),0)<=p(k)<=p(q). Segment builder clips each page span to the position window before kernel execution.
implementation_prompt: Specify page-segment clipping for SWA layers and how per-layer window differences affect reusable gather metadata.

objective: Extend paged tree attention metadata for hybrid recurrent/cache layers.
mathematical_spec: For a layer l with memory mode m_l, use paged ancestry KV only when m_l=ATTENTION; recurrent states remain sequence/branch scoped and require fork/rollback semantics distinct from token KV pages.
implementation_prompt: Define an integration boundary so Tree PagedAttention does not incorrectly treat recurrent state as ordinary KV. Identify metadata hooks required for hybrid models without implementing recurrent kernels.

objective: Define GQA/MQA head mapping over paged KV storage.
mathematical_spec: For query head h_q and n_q/n_kv grouping ratio g=n_q/n_kv, KV head h_kv=floor(h_q/g). Page addressing is token-major within each layer while head mapping remains independent of tree topology.
implementation_prompt: Specify head-indexing rules and tensor strides for MHA, GQA, and MQA so page tables do not duplicate per-head topology metadata.

objective: Define quantized KV page compatibility for Tree PagedAttention.
mathematical_spec: For K/V types tau_K,tau_V, page strides must satisfy quant block granularity and dequantization reads may span only initialized valid ranges. Geometry is valid iff P*d_head aligns with each type's block requirements.
implementation_prompt: Specify validation and dispatch metadata for supported KV dtypes/quantization. Mark unsupported combinations as explicit fallback conditions.

objective: Define RoPE position semantics for shared tree KV.
mathematical_spec: Stored K for token v must be rotated using its logical position p(v) exactly once. Shared prefix pages are reusable across branches only while their logical positions remain identical; branch-local position shifts invalidate direct sharing unless keys are transformed consistently.
implementation_prompt: Specify logical-position ownership for RoPE and how context shifts or sequence position transforms interact with shared pages. Prefer restrictions that avoid rewriting shared K.

objective: Define context-shift behavior for canonical and speculative branches.
mathematical_spec: A shift delta applied to canonical prefix changes logical positions and possibly RoPE state for affected keys. Speculative descendants may remain valid only if their ancestry mapping undergoes the same transform; otherwise they must be pruned before shift.
implementation_prompt: Specify safe ordering between context shift, speculative tree lifetime, page sharing, and branch pruning. Align with existing seq_add/seq_rm semantics where feasible.

objective: Define packed Tree PagedAttention query descriptors.
mathematical_spec: Descriptor per packed query r contains branch handle, logical position, query row, segment range [row_ptr_r,row_ptr_{r+1}), and optional layer window id. Descriptor validity requires branch generation match at execution.
implementation_prompt: Specify compact query descriptor arrays used by execution planners and kernels, including generation validation and stable ordering back to sampler logits.

objective: Define a CPU reference Tree PagedAttention algorithm for correctness.
mathematical_spec: For each query q and head h, compute s_k=(Q_qh dot K_k,h_kv)/sqrt(d)+mask(q,k), softmax over exactly visible k, then O_qh=sum_k softmax(s)_k V_k,h_kv. Iterate logical ancestry order from page segments.
implementation_prompt: Specify a deliberately simple reference algorithm and numerical tolerance contract to serve as oracle for optimized backends. No performance optimization.

objective: Define numerical equivalence tests between dense-tree masking and paged gathering.
mathematical_spec: For identical Q,K,V and tree topology, require ||O_paged-O_dense|| within dtype-specific atol/rtol and identical allowed-key sets. Test random trees, page boundaries, forks, partial pages, SWA, GQA, and quantized supported types.
implementation_prompt: Specify property-based test generation and comparison metrics. Include deterministic seeds and minimal counterexample reporting.

objective: Define concurrent reader/writer phase boundaries for one decode step.
mathematical_spec: Execution phase order is RESERVE -> WRITE -> PUBLISH -> ATTEND -> VERIFY -> COMMIT/PRUNE. Metadata mutations that can invalidate reader addresses occur only after ATTEND readers signal completion or use versioned snapshots.
implementation_prompt: Specify the concurrency state machine and allowed operations in each phase. Identify which transitions require locks, atomics, backend events, or scheduler serialization.

objective: Define snapshot consistency for page tables consumed asynchronously by GPU work.
mathematical_spec: A snapshot S=(epoch,PT_version,descriptor_generations) remains valid through kernel completion. Writers create version v+1 out of place or defer destructive mutation until all readers of v retire.
implementation_prompt: Specify snapshot acquisition/release and version publication for branch/page metadata. Favor scheduler-level epochs over per-entry atomics where sufficient.

objective: Define ABA-resistant page reuse under asynchronous work.
mathematical_spec: A physical page id p may be recycled from generation g to g+1 only after all handles/snapshots referencing (p,g) quiesce. Any dereference requires descriptor.generation==captured_generation.
implementation_prompt: Specify generation width, comparison points, and failure diagnostics for stale page references across allocator reuse.

objective: Define failure atomicity for multi-branch reservation and publication.
mathematical_spec: For operation O touching pages P and branches B, either all intended PT/version updates become visible together or none do. On pre-publication failure, RESERVED pages return to free pool; post-publication failure requires a compensating rollback using recorded old versions.
implementation_prompt: Specify transaction metadata and rollback records for one draft-step cache update, keeping scope local to scheduler step rather than introducing a general transaction subsystem.

objective: Define invariant-focused stress tests for fork/append/rollback/prune concurrency.
mathematical_spec: Generate operation traces over valid state machine actions and assert ID_080 invariants after each quiescent point. Include randomized forks, page-boundary appends, COW, failed reservations, delayed readers, rollback, and id reuse.
implementation_prompt: Specify deterministic randomized stress scenarios and a small model checker/state simulator for metadata only. Focus on refcount, generation, and lifetime bugs.

objective: Define performance counters for tree paged KV management.
mathematical_spec: Track allocations, reused pages, COW bytes, refcount ops, tail waste, prune latency, reservation failures, gather segments/query, metadata upload bytes, and attention page touches. Counters must not alter synchronization in release builds when disabled.
implementation_prompt: Specify counter names, units, collection scopes, and step-level aggregation suitable for llama-bench-style reporting and profiling.

objective: Define end-to-end integration contract between speculative tree scheduler, KV manager, and attention planner.
mathematical_spec: For each step input tree D and canonical state C, KV manager returns reservation/write plan W; attention planner consumes published snapshot S; verifier returns accepted path A; commit produces C' such that C' equals C extended by A and all non-surviving speculative references are retired safely.
implementation_prompt: Specify interface boundaries, data ownership, call ordering, error propagation, and fallback to non-tree decoding. Keep the contract implementable without changing unrelated public APIs.

objective: Define the Pilar B acceptance suite and formal completion criteria.
mathematical_spec: Acceptance requires: exact logical equivalence to dense/reference attention; zero leaked LIVE pages after branch teardown; refcount reconciliation; stale-generation rejection; restore isomorphism; pressure/failure rollback; and bounded metadata overhead O(B+P_live+M) for branches B, live pages P_live, gather segments M.
implementation_prompt: Specify the final validation matrix covering unit, property, stress, restore, concurrency, and performance-regression checks. State pass/fail criteria and artifacts required before implementation can be considered complete.
